title: run_code
description: Execute a code snippet the candidate dictated, in a sandbox, and return its output. Only call this when the candidate has dictated actual, complete source code. Do NOT call it for a verbal description of an approach, for an answer containing no code, or when you simply want to assess the candidate. Optional fields accept null: the model emits null to mean 'no preference', and rejecting that spends a repair turn on a call that was not actually wrong. Required fields stay strict, where a null IS a mistake worth correcting.
